the double penguin contributions to the decays of B to Vgamma, where V is a light vector meson, are small and that these contributions can be neglected in a fit for the CKM parameters.

the double penguin diagrams contribute to the decays of $B$ mesons into $K^* \gamma$, $\rho \gamma$, $K \gamma$, and $\rho \gamma$ and the contribution to $B \rightarrow\rho \gamma$ is comparable to the one to $B \to K^* \mu^+ \mu^-$.
